Clean up this demo

Deletes the disposable GitHub repository and confirmed app sessions from the core session. Removing the local Copilot app project is a final manual step.

Requires GitHub CLI sign-in and repository creation rights. Never merge or deploy the demo security PR. GitHub Actions may consume minutes; environments are not deleted automatically. Copilot Autofix availability depends on GitHub processing and account policy; a generated fix is not guaranteed.

Delete this demo environment?

This deletes on GitHub and removes these app sessions, including their uncommitted work:

    The core repository is never deleted. You will return to its session for cleanup, then remove the local demo project manually in the app.

    Only retry after checking that the previous cleanup request is no longer running.
